tutorial.text: Swipe across a fuse to snip it! You have a limited number of snips, so make each cut count.
Sparks start one at a time — watch the delay, snip each fuse as it ignites.
Every fuse passes through the same point. One well-placed cut snips them all!
This wick lights ANOTHER wick mid-burn! Snip the first fuse EARLY to stop it — or cut the new wick it lights.
Some fuses run straight to the bomb — no crossroads to find. Track every wick, not just the crossings.
TWO wicks light other wicks now. Cut a parent EARLY to stop its chain — or be ready to snip every new wick it lights.
